title: Checking hairpin and adapter DNA [DAF-SELEX] - repeat
body:
### 1. Hairpin & Adapter Gel Run

Prepare 1 µM working dilutions, then load each sample at 1 pmol and 3 pmol to check whether the extra bands persist at lower loading.

*Prepare the working dilutions*
Use the same 1× annealing buffer for all dilutions: 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, and 50 mM NaCl.
For the three individual oligos supplied at 100 µM, first make separate 10 µM intermediates:
| Sample | 100 µM stock | 1× annealing buffer | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Non-annealed hairpin | 2 µL | 18 µL | 20 µL |
| Adapter A | 2 µL | 18 µL | 20 µL |
| Adapter B | 2 µL | 18 µL | 20 µL |

Next, prepare 1 µM working solutions for all five samples:

| Sample | Source at 10 µM | 1× annealing buffer | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Non-annealed hairpin | 5 µL of intermediate | 45 µL | 50 µL |
| Annealed hairpin | 5 µL of folded preparation | 45 µL | 50 µL |
| Adapter A | 5 µL of intermediate | 45 µL | 50 µL |
| Adapter B | 5 µL of intermediate | 45 µL | 50 µL |
| Annealed A+B | 5 µL of annealed preparation | 45 µL | 50 µL |

Loading tubes:

| Component | Low-load tube: 1 pmol | Higher-load tube: 3 pmol |
|---|---:|---:|
| Sample, 1 µM | 1 µL | 3 µL |
| 1× annealing buffer | 7 µL | 5 µL |
| 5× native loading buffer | 2 µL | 2 µL |
| **Total volume loaded** | **10 µL** | **10 µL** |

Loading order for gel (20% TBE gel):

| Lane | Sample | Amount |
|---|---|---:|
| 1 | 50 bp DNA ladder | Manufacturer-recommended amount |
| 2 | Non-annealed hairpin | 1 pmol |
| 3 | Annealed hairpin | 1 pmol |
| 4 | Adapter A | 1 pmol |
| 5 | Adapter B | 1 pmol |
| 6 | Annealed A+B | 1 pmol |
| 7 | Non-annealed hairpin | 3 pmol |
| 8 | Annealed hairpin | 3 pmol |
| 9 | Adapter A | 3 pmol |
| 10 | Adapter B | 3 pmol |
| 11 | Annealed A+B | 3 pmol |
| 12 |TriDye 100 bp ladder| 10 µL |


Run the gel at 150 V, 45 mins with constant checking of the dye front.
Stain the gel for an hour with SYBR Green stain (prepared in 1X TBE)
